introduction: The coronavirus pandemic has forced millions of people worldwide to get used to meeting others only

vocabulary.definition: the action of creating a sense of separation or remoteness between individuals
vocabulary.example: The lack of eye contact in online meetings often creates a distancing effect.

vocabulary.definition: the act of thinking about information carefully in order to understand it
vocabulary.example: When we process new ideas, we need to take time to analyze and comprehend them fully.

vocabulary.definition: the state of occurring or existing simultaneously or in agreement
vocabulary.example: The group of friends started laughing in unison when they heard the joke.

vocabulary.definition: a method of generating new ideas or solutions through a group discussion
vocabulary.example: During the brainstorming session, we came up with innovative ways to improve the project.
Creating intentional moments in meetings can help foster better communication among team members.

vocabulary.definition: to understand or grasp the meaning of something
vocabulary.example: It took me a while to comprehend the complex instructions, but after reading them carefully, I understood.
